description: Joins the channels of up to five polyphonic inputs end to end into one polyphonic output

inputs.text: One of five inputs whose channels are added to the output in turn; the lamp colour shows which input each output channel came from

outputs.text: Carries the channels of every patched input one after another, stopping at 16 channels

notes: the sixteen lamps stand for the sixteen channels of the output, each lit in the colour of the input jack that channel was taken from and dark where there is no channel
bypassing this module passes the first input straight to the output
